Bill.BriefDescription: Repealing unnecessary provisions concerning the Washington State Bar Association.

BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that the WashingtonState Bar Association was initially established by the legislature asa state agency. Since that time the State Supreme Court has taken overas the entity regulating members of the state bar, and has opined that,"the ultimate power to regulate courtrelated functions, including theadministration of the Bar Association, belongs exclusively to thiscourt." WSBA v. State of Washington, 125 Wn.2d 901 (1995). Therefore,the legislature intends to repeal statutes establishing the barassociation and regulation of members of the bar.

The following acts or parts of acts are eachrepealed: RCW 2.48.010 (Objects and powers) and 1933 c 94 s 2; RCW 2.48.020 (First members) and 1933 c 94 s 3; RCW 2.48.021 (New members) and 1933 c 94 s 4; RCW 2.48.030 (Board of governors) and 1982 1st ex.s. c 30 s 1,1972 ex.s. c 66 s 1, & 1933 c 94 s 5; RCW 2.48.035 (Board of governorsMembershipEffect ofcreation of new congressional districts or boundaries) and 1982 1stex.s. c 30 s 2; RCW 2.48.040 (State bar governed by board of governors) and1933 c 94 s 6; RCW 2.48.050 (Powers of governors) and 1933 c 94 s 7; RCW 2.48.060 (Admission and disbarment) and 1933 c 94 s 8; RCW 2.48.070 (Admission of veterans) and 1945 c 181 s 1; RCW 2.48.080 (Admission of veteransEstablishment ofrequirements if in service) and 2011 c 336 s 63 & 1945 c 181 s 2; RCW 2.48.090 (Admission of veteransEstablishment ofrequirements if discharged) and 2011 c 336 s 64 & 1945 c 181 s 3; RCW 2.48.100 (Admission of veteransEffect of disabilitydischarge) and 1945 c 181 s 4; RCW 2.48.110 (Admission of veteransFees of veterans) and1945 c 181 s 5; RCW 2.48.130 (Membership feeActive) and 1957 c 138 s 1, 1953c 256 s 1, & 1933 c 94 s 9; RCW 2.48.140 (Membership feeInactive) and 1955 c 34 s 1 &1933 c 94 s 10; RCW 2.48.150 (Admission fees) and 2011 c 336 s 65 & 1933 c 94s 11; RCW 2.48.160 (Suspension for nonpayment of fees) and 2011 c336 s 66 & 1933 c 94 s 12; RCW 2.48.165 (Disbarment or license suspensionNonpayment ordefault on educational loan or scholarship) and 1996 c 293 s 1; RCW 2.48.166 (Admission to or suspension from practiceNoncompliance with support orderRules) and 1997 c 58 s 810; RCW 2.48.170 (Only active members may practice law) and 2011c 336 s 67 & 1933 c 94 s 13; RCW 2.48.210 (Oath on admission) and 1921 c 126 s 12; HB 1335 p. 2 RCW 2.48.220 (Grounds of disbarment or suspension) and 2011 c336 s 68 & 1921 c 126 s 14 & 1909 c 139 s 7; and RCW 2.48.230 (Code of ethics) and 1921 c 126 s 15.
RCW 2.48.180, 2.48.190, and 2.48.200 areeach recodified as sections in chapter 2.44 RCW.
